admission: Only the three compiled-in SHA-256 hashes may execute; this manifest is documentation, never an execution allowlist supplied by a caller.
loading: External source_root containing source/. No automatic fetch, external package initializers, bytecode cache, Torch, or wholesale IsaacLab imports.
adaptation: Only MjWarpActuatorBridge._model_friction_solver_attributes is overridden to use the passed Newton model instead of NewtonManager.
limits: One 14-revolute-DOF battery group, one MJWarp world, explicit q and DOF indices.
No other MJWarp/Newton actuator pipelines; model gains/target_mode must already be zero on owned joints.
Exactly one before_step call per consecutive stage.simulation_step_count and cfg.num_substeps=1; physics_dt is explicit.
Caller must synchronize model properties before before_step; no notification between friction publish and solve.
Host checks run outside CUDA graph capture; CUDA/Kit performance and MicroDuck locomotion require independent integration evidence.
No PhysX or MuJoCo-C support; no body-wrench contribution in upstream load estimator.
Profiles are named candidate configurations, not historical ONNX-training provenance or physically admitted defaults.
Model/mesh/weight licenses are separate; this BSD notice does not relicense MicroDuck assets.

official_infer_nominal_no_delay.parameters: Official inference defaults: kp200,vin7.4,sag.1,vin_min6,currentNone,delay0,stiff friction; voltage effort cap = vin*kt/R.
official_infer_nominal_no_delay.scope: Actuator parameter correspondence only. Native Newton/MJWarp and CPU MuJoCo plants/solvers are distinct; neither this name nor parameter matching admits gait.
official_infer_nominal_no_delay.historical_difference: Earlier nominal profiles keep soft friction and .96 Nm cap, explicitly preserved as separate candidates, not exact official inference settings.
